rationale: The workshop door sensor (SEN-D1) is bound in both base and app, has good battery (75%), strong RSSI (-60 dBm), and compatible firmware (v3 supported by HB-200). Despite a fresh battery and being held next to the base station, the LED stays completely dark when SYNC is pressed — no blue or red blink — indicating the device is not powering on or responding at all. All other sensors from the same box work, ruling out a system-level or setup issue, so this is a hardware fault requiring escalation.

results.text: Peripheral firmware is upgraded over the air (OTA) from the base station. Requirements: device within normal signal range, battery above 30 percent. CAM-S1 1.x upgrades to 2.1 (protocol v3). SEN-D1 1.0 upgrades to 1.3, SEN-M1 1.1 upgrades to 1.4. CAM-I2 hardware revision A with firmware 1.2 cannot be upgraded to protocol v3.

Peripherals talk to the base station over a sub-GHz proprietary radio. Signal strength (RSSI) is shown in Device Settings > Device Info. Above -70 dBm is good, -70 to -80 dBm is acceptable, below -80 dBm causes intermittent disconnections, delayed notifications and choppy live view. Concrete walls, metal doors and fridges strongly attenuate the signal. Fix: move the device or base station, or install the official RP-1 repeater.
